intro: Merge magic eggs, hatch enchanted kittens and fill the witch's album with every form.
description:
The witch's cauldron is full of kittens. Drop magic eggs into the cauldron and let them merge. Match two of a kind and something bigger appears, climbing from a tiny caracal all the way up to a golden tiger. Easy to pick up, hard to put down.

Merges score points, points become stars, and stars go into the witch's album to unlock new breeds and awaken new forms. Chain your merges for glowing combos. Clear the cauldron completely for a Perfect Round. And take care with a spell that isn't ready yet — unfinished magic turns your cats to quiet stone.

Every few rounds the witch leans in with a word of advice, a bit of lore, or a small proud smile when you beat your best.

Features
• Cosy merge puzzle — easy to learn, hard to stop
• 11 elemental cat breeds and 33 forms to hatch, grow and collect
• A magical album to fill
• Stars, upgrades and combo chains for players who like to optimise
• A friendly witch companion who follows you through every round
• Storybook art in warm candlelight colours and an original cosy soundtrack
• No timers, no rush — play one round in five minutes, or stay with the kittens all evening

How many kittens can one cauldron hold?
